title: Inheritance as an Admission Test for LLM Prompt Merge Operators

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents are often improved by iterating until a fixed verifier is done. Once that verifier saturates, the loop has nothing left to climb. We instead score agents against the current population, and a frozen panel records whether anyone got better. The panel mean can rise inside the seeds by elimination alone. We therefore count a run as training only when its final mean beats the best generation-zero member. A merge is admitted only when the child moves toward the donor, past the child the same operator produces at zero dose, and the lower confidence bound on that movement reaches half the requested dose. That is the admission test. A detectable shortfall rejects the operator, and the test is otherwise undetermined. We keep realised fitness ϕ \phi as the selector and reference performance θ \theta as the unused ruler. Every measurement uses gemini-3.1-flash-lite on one negotiation task, and no fixed-oracle arm was run. In the open loop, tactic append grafts short donor rules and is admitted. Free rewrite moves only a third of the requested dose and is rejected. Template append pastes raw donor replies into the child. Its movement clears the bound on the first probe but not on the re-probe, and it is left undetermined. A held-out re-probe on the five situations the merge never saw confirms that both appends move, and it does not rescue free rewrite. Neither append rises with the dose. Constrained rewrite is admitted in the open loop and was not run in the closed loop, which changes only the operator. The population, the scores and the task stay fixed. No free-rewrite run beats the best generation-zero member. Every tactic-append run and every template-append run does. Sampled loop children keep that split. Free rewrite moves no further toward the donor, and both appends still clear the bound, by less than in the open loop.

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents are usually improved by iterating until a fixed verifier is satisfied ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) , and the same shape governs fine-tuning and human feedback ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ) . Once the verifier is satisfied, the loop has nothing left to climb. We therefore score each agent against opponents drawn from the current population, and no weights are updated. Realised fitness ϕ \phi is then relative. It ranks the population at every generation, but it cannot certify progress, because a population in which every agent improves still faces only itself. We read progress instead on reference performance θ \theta against a panel frozen at initialisation, and ϕ \phi stays the selector. That decoupling is the setting of this paper, not its contribution.

paragraphs.en: The setting has a weakness, and that weakness motivates the paper. The panel mean can rise inside the seeds by elimination alone, because selection keeps the better seeds and discards the worse. A climb therefore does not show that children inherit anything from their donors. Whether they do is a property of the merge operator, and that operator is what we test.

paragraphs.en: The objects are concrete. Each agent is one frozen LLM with its own system prompt, and the population is a set of such prompts. A merge takes a recipient prompt, a behavioural trace of a donor and a requested dose β \beta , the fraction of the donor the child is asked to inherit, and it returns a child prompt. We study four such operators (Table 1 ). Two rewrite the recipient and two append to it. Their effect is read on a behaviour profile, the frequencies with which a prompt claims each issue of a negotiation game, or accepts, on a fixed battery of scripted situations.

paragraphs.en: We offer two contributions. The first is the admission test of RQ1. It scores a merge against the operator’s own zero-dose child rather than against the recipient, and that baseline is what separates inherited movement from paraphrase drift. It admits on a confidence bound rather than on a failure to detect a shortfall. The second is the closed-loop protocol of RQ2. A run counts as training only when its final mean beats the best generation-zero member, which elimination alone cannot do, and sampled loop children are re-tested with the same admission test.

paragraphs.en: The trajectory of LLM systems has run from the static model to the tool-using agent ( Yao et al., 2022 ) and cooperating multi-agent systems ( Wu et al., 2023 ) . Unlike those orchestration frameworks, our agents never divide a task between them, and the output is a population rather than a workflow. Closest to our work are methods that optimise a prompt or an agent program against a task metric. Some use textual gradients ( Pryzant et al., 2023 ) or an LLM acting as the optimiser or compiler ( Yang et al., 2024 ) . Others run an evolutionary search over prompt strings ( Guo et al., 2023 ) , including language-model crossover ( Meyerson et al., 2023 ) and self-referential prompt evolution ( Fernando et al., 2023 ) . Those methods use the parents as in-context examples and sample a new complete prompt. They do not keep the recipient and append the donor.
paragraphs.zh: 大模型系统的发展轨迹从静态模型一路走到了使用工具的智能体（Yao et al., 2022）以及协作的多智能体系统（Wu et al., 2023）。 与那些编排框架不同，我们的智能体从不在彼此之间划分任务，其输出是一个种群而非一个工作流。 与我们的工作最接近的是那些针对任务指标优化提示词或智能体程序的方法。 其中一些使用文本梯度（Pryzant et al., 2023），或让大模型充当优化器或编译器（Yang et al., 2024）。 另一些则对提示词字符串运行进化搜索（Guo et al., 2023），包括语言模型交叉（Meyerson et al., 2023）和自引用提示词进化（Fernando et al., 2023）。 这些方法将父代用作上下文示例，并采样出一个全新的完整提示词。 它们并不保留接收方并追加供体。

ExpeL and Agent Workflow Memory distil rules from experience and append them to a prompt ( Zhao et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) . paragraphs.en: The same neighbourhood now includes later LLM evolution. AlphaEvolve ( Novikov et al., 2025 ) edits an existing program, and GEPA ( Agrawal et al., 2025 ) edits an existing prompt in light of its rollouts. ShinkaEvolve and the Darwin Gödel Machine ( Lange et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) evolve programs against a task metric, and EvoAgent ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) evolves a specialist into a multi-agent system by mutation and crossover of agent settings. None of them scores the change against the operator’s own zero-dose child.
paragraphs.zh: 同一个领域如今还包含了后续的大语言模型演化工作。 AlphaEvolve（Novikov et al., 2025）对已有程序进行编辑，而 GEPA（Agrawal et al., 2025）则根据其 rollout 结果对已有提示词进行编辑。 ShinkaEvolve 和达尔文·哥德尔机（Lange et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2025）针对任务度量对程序进行演化，而 EvoAgent（Yuan et al., 2025）通过对智能体设置进行变异和交叉，将一个专用智能体演化成多智能体系统。 它们都没有将改动与算子自身的零剂量子代进行对比评分。

paragraphs.en: The setting inherits from classical evolutionary computation. Competitive coevolution ( Hillis, 1990 ; Rosin and Belew, 1997 ) and its reinforcement-learning counterpart self-play ( Silver et al., 2018 ) induce the frequency-dependent dynamics we analyse ( Hofbauer and Sigmund, 1998 ) . More recently, foundation-model self-play has brought these dynamics to LLM-driven evolution ( Dharna et al., 2025 ) . That method freezes the model as well, but it uses the model as a code-level search operator that writes a new program from the opponent and the match result. We instead keep the model as the player, and the genome is a prompt that must inherit. That tradition also supplies our measurement problem and its pathologies of disengagement, cycling and mediocre stable states ( Watson and Pollack, 2001 ) . The frozen panel of Section 3.1 is the simplest of its archives ( Lanctot et al., 2017 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 该设定继承自经典进化计算。 竞争性协同进化（Hillis, 1990；Rosin and Belew, 1997）及其在强化学习中的对应物自我博弈（Silver et al., 2018）诱发了我们所分析的频率依赖动力学（Hofbauer and Sigmund, 1998）。 最近，基础模型的自我博弈将这些动力学带入了由大语言模型驱动的进化（Dharna et al., 2025）。 该方法同样冻结模型，但它将模型用作代码层面的搜索算子，根据对手和比赛结果编写新程序。 我们则让模型继续充当玩家，而基因组是一个必须可继承的提示词。 这一传统也提供了我们的测量问题及其病态现象：脱离、循环和平庸的稳定状态（Watson and Pollack, 2001）。 3.1 节的冻结面板是其档案库中最简单的一种（Lanctot et al., 2017）。

paragraphs.en: The merge itself also has classical counterparts. Geometric semantic crossover places the child on the segment between its parents ( Moraglio et al., 2012 ) . We call that placement a blend. A blend inherits exactly the requested dose, but it never leaves the hull of the seeds. Open-ended and quality-diversity search ( Lehman and Stanley, 2011 ) instead seeks the variation a blend cannot supply, a child outside the hull of its seeds. Remark 3.2 distinguishes that hull escape from inherited change.
paragraphs.zh: 合并本身也有经典对应物。 几何语义交叉将子代置于其两个父代之间的线段上（Moraglio 等，2012）。 我们把这种放置称为混合。 混合恰好继承所请求的剂量，但它永远不会离开种子的凸包。 开放式与质量多样性搜索（Lehman 和 Stanley，2011）则寻求混合无法提供的变化，即位于其种子凸包之外的子代。 注记 3.2 将这种凸包逃逸与继承性变化区分开来。

paragraphs.en: We model competitive survival as a steady-state coevolutionary process over a fixed population of N N agents. Each generation adds k k children by a merge operator and removes k k agents by rank-proportional elimination, returning the population to N N . No weights are updated, and evolution acts on strategies alone. An agent is scored against its current rivals rather than a fixed oracle.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将竞争性生存建模为在 N N 个智能体的固定种群上进行的稳态协同进化过程。 每一代通过一个合并算子加入 k k 个子代，并通过按排名比例淘汰的方式移除 k k 个智能体，使种群规模回到 N N。 不更新任何权重，进化仅作用于策略。 每个智能体针对其当前的对手进行评分，而非针对固定的基准。

paragraphs.en: Those agents play a structured variant of the Deal or No Deal task ( Lewis et al., 2017 ) . The game has three indivisible issues, a patent, a territory and a staffing decision. Each issue goes wholly to one side. To reach a deal, the two agents exchange six messages rather than free dialogue. Each message is a proposal of an allocation or an acceptance of the offer on the table. Each side holds private values for the three issues. Both sides score zero if they never agree, and an agent’s score is otherwise the share of its total value that the deal captures.
paragraphs.zh: 这些智能体玩一个结构化版本的「成交还是不成交」任务（Lewis 等人，2017）。 该博弈包含三个不可分割的议题：一项专利、一块领地和一个人事决定。 每个议题整体归属于其中一方。 为了达成交易，两个智能体交换六条消息，而不是自由对话。 每条消息要么是对某种分配方案的提议，要么是对当前所给提议的接受。 每一方对这三个议题持有私有的价值评估。 如果双方始终未能达成一致，则双方得分均为零；否则，智能体的得分为该交易所获取的其总价值的份额。

paragraphs.en: The admission test asks whether Δ ​ s \Delta s reaches the requested dose. Movement and shortfall are each read by a one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test over the sixteen pairs, and the operator is rejected when that test detects a shortfall. But a shortfall that goes undetected is not a dose delivered, because sixteen pairs with a spread of 0.3 cannot tell Δ ​ s = 0.30 \Delta s=0.30 from Δ ​ s = 0.15 \Delta s=0.15 . Admission therefore rests on a bound rather than on a non-rejection. We take the one-sided 95% lower confidence bound on Δ ​ s \Delta s that the signed-rank test implies, the Hodges-Lehmann bound, and we admit the operator only when that bound reaches half the requested dose. Half the reference effect is the common non-inferiority margin, and it sits well above the detection limit of 0.06. An operator that is neither rejected nor admitted is undetermined, which is a statement about the sample rather than about the operator. The full battery decides, and an admission stands only if the re-probe of the same children clears the bound as well. paragraphs.en: Because free rewrite’s failure belongs to the operator, the loop needs transmission (Proposition 3.1 ), not hull membership (Remark 3.2 ). The failure also reaches beyond this paper. PromptBreeder, EvoPrompt and language-model crossover ( Fernando et al., 2023 ; Guo et al., 2023 ; Meyerson et al., 2023 ) recombine by operators of the same kind, which sample a new complete prompt from the parents’ text. If those operators transmit as ours does, their selection step chooses parents whose behaviour the child does not reliably inherit, and the operator supplies fresh variation in their place. An audit of LLM evolution in equation discovery points the same way, finding instructed crossover no better than fresh sampling ( Li, 2026 ) . paragraphs.en: Fig. 3 shows that mean reference performance climbs under all three operators, but we count a run as training only if its final mean beats the best generation-zero member. Each seed’s generation-zero score in one run rests on six matches, and the largest of twelve such estimates is noisy. Across the nine runs it ranges from 0.737 to 0.880 for the same twelve prompts. We therefore pool each seed’s generation-zero scores across the nine runs, 54 matches per seed, and the best seed then scores 0.771. That is the bar for every run. Tactic append rises from 0.65 to 0.850, and every run’s final mean clears the bar (0.838, 0.852 and 0.858). Free rewrite rises from 0.66 to 0.738, and no run clears it (0.757, 0.718 and 0.739). That climb stays inside the seeds. Template append rises from 0.65 to 0.835, and every run clears the bar (0.836, 0.818 and 0.852). It pastes raw donor replies, and the held-out block of Section 4 confirms that the movement is real. Against each run’s own six-match bar the counts are two of three, none of three and three of three, and the one miss is the tactic-append run that drew the 0.880 bar while its mean rose from 0.652 to 0.838.

paragraphs.en: Iterating against a fixed verifier stops once the verifier is satisfied. Scoring against the current population keeps a target that moves with the population, and the frozen panel with the best-seed bar reports whether that movement is progress. The gain is not efficiency, which we did not measure against a fixed-oracle arm, but a target that does not saturate and a reading of progress that elimination cannot fake.
paragraphs.zh: 针对固定验证器的迭代在验证器满足后即停止。 针对当前种群进行评分会保持一个随种群移动的目标，而带有最佳种子门槛的冻结评审团则报告这种移动是否是进步。 我们并未针对固定oracle分支测量效率，因此收益不在于效率，而在于一个不会饱和的目标，以及一种淘汰无法伪造的进步判读。

paragraphs.en: Competitive survival guarantees a ranking at every generation (Section 3 ), and a frozen panel records whether the population climbed (Eq. 2 ). A ranking by itself does not certify progress, and elimination alone can lift the panel mean without anyone leaving the seeds. Training is therefore read against the best seed, not against the starting mean. Whether a run can clear that mark is a property of the operator, not of the tournament.
paragraphs.zh: 竞争性生存保证每一代都有一个排名（第3节），而一个冻结的记录面板记录种群是否有所攀升（公式2）。 排名本身并不能证明进步，仅靠淘汰就可以在不淘汰任何种子的情况下抬高面板均值。 因此，训练要以最佳种子为基准来评判，而不是以初始均值为基准。 一次运行能否越过这一标线，是算子的属性，而不是锦标赛的属性。

paragraphs.en: On RQ1, free rewrite leaves the parent line, but it moves only a third of the requested dose and is rejected. Tactic append clears the half-dose bound on both probes and leaves the line without pasting raw donor replies, and the held-out situations confirm it. Template append makes no model call and pastes raw donor replies. Its movement is real on the five situations the merge never saw, but its bound clears the bar on one probe of the full battery of Section 4 and not on the other, hence it is undetermined, and neither append rises with the dose. On RQ2, the open-loop verdict predicted the closed loop for both decided operators that entered it, and the undetermined operator trained as well. In the closed loop, no free-rewrite run clears that mark, and every tactic-append run and every template-append run does. Sampled loop children keep that split, and both appends clear the admission bound inside the loop while free rewrite is rejected. Every measurement uses one model on one negotiation task, with sixteen pairs in the open loop and three runs per operator in the closed loop, and both appends drive the population toward copies of a few agents.
paragraphs.zh: 关于 RQ1，自由重写离开了父系，但其移动量仅为所请求剂量的三分之一，因而被拒绝。 策略追加在两个探针上都突破了半剂量界限，并且在不粘贴原始供体回复的情况下离开了父系，留出的情形也证实了这一点。 模板追加不进行任何模型调用，而是直接粘贴原始供体回复。 在合并从未见过的五个情形上，其移动是真实的，但其界限在第 4 节完整测试组的一个探针上越过了门槛，而在另一个上没有，因此结果未定，且两种追加都不随剂量上升。 关于 RQ2，开环判定正确预测了进入其中的两个已判定操作符的闭环表现，而未判定操作符的训练效果同样良好。 在闭环中，没有任何自由重写运行达到该标准，而每一个策略追加运行和每一个模板追加运行都达到了。 抽样得到的循环子代保持了这一划分，两种追加都在循环内突破了准入界限，而自由重写则被拒绝。 每项测量都使用单一模型在单一协商任务上进行，开环包含十六对，闭环中每个操作符运行三次，且两种追加都使种群趋向于少数几个智能体的副本。
